method.purpose: Rank future work by realistic parser impact supported by repository evidence, not by recency, raw discovery score, or implementation convenience.
method.tie_break: dependency leverage, correctness impact, evidence readiness, scope certainty, topic balance, then lower cost
evidence_boundaries: parser output and tests are implementation evidence only
pedagogical and corpus attestations prove occurrence in context, not unrestricted productivity
identity state does not authorize runtime or status changes
mutable survey counts are not final evidence

recommended_next.title: AA56 positive 有 participant introduction
recommended_next.why: It combines the largest central grammar gain with completed source/corpus boundaries, a reproducible two-direction runtime mismatch, and an explicit accepted next step: retained-UUID identity migration plus positive-only parser specification.

candidate_clusters.title: AA56 positive 有 participant introduction
candidate_clusters.trigger: Accepted research found 44 clear positive rows in a complete 179-row bounded review and separated AA55, AA77, partitive, temporal, lexical, inventory, and negative-human boundaries.
candidate_clusters.evidence_state: Two verified independent sources plus a 1,372-row mechanical inventory and complete bounded review; identity migration and specification are the stated next dependency.
candidate_clusters.runtime_observation: Current detector is too narrow because it requires a locative coda and too broad because it merges negative 冇人 clauses.
candidate_clusters.expected_parser_benefit: Correct a central subjectless participant-introduction family and establish safe composition among possession, overt-place existence, and NP-linked predication.
risks: risk of conflating existential, possession, partitive, temporal, and negative quantification
candidate_clusters.cancellation_condition: No reusable relation remains after independently typed existential and predicate composition.

candidate_clusters.title: 有得／冇得 availability and opportunity
candidate_clusters.trigger: Exhaustive 95-span review found 31 affirmative and 32 negative transparent profiles, five polarity questions, bounded ellipsis, and lexicalized controls.
candidate_clusters.evidence_state: Direct scholarly support, verified HKCanCor distribution, full expert classification, and explicit recursive stop.
candidate_clusters.runtime_observation: Availability relation is absent or fragmented; generic ModalVP, ordinary A-not-A, existential 有／冇, and postverbal potential are insufficient.
candidate_clusters.expected_parser_benefit: Add a common availability relation while preserving polarity, embedding, objects, ellipsis, and lexicalized boundaries.
risks: suppletive polarity could be misread as ordinary V-not-V
candidate_clusters.cancellation_condition: Existing typed components preserve the full availability relation without a new identity.

candidate_clusters.title: Context-linked short responses across Glossika
candidate_clusters.trigger: The complete twenty-dialog packet contains 59 NeedsContext turns with preserved previous/next speaker adjacency.
candidate_clusters.evidence_state: Finite pedagogical corpus packet with exact turns and adjacency; the work is classification, not independent grammar proof.
candidate_clusters.runtime_observation: NeedsContext mixes legitimate ellipsis/context dependence, formulas, fragments, ordinary misses, and member-local diagnostics.
candidate_clusters.expected_parser_benefit: Separate correct unresolved diagnostics from recoverable previous-turn relations and independent parser defects across all twenty dialogs.
risks: context relation may have a large null outcome
candidate_clusters.cancellation_condition: All 59 diagnostics are correctly unresolved and no reusable relation or independent defect exists.

candidate_clusters.title: Typed paired clause relations
candidate_clusters.trigger: Eleven source-backed PRQ2 units have 147 bounded collision probes while generic ClauseRelationGraph/ClauseSpan output is frequent.
candidate_clusters.evidence_state: Direct source packages exist for PRQ2-008–015 and PRQ2-033–035; distributional maturity varies by relation.
candidate_clusters.runtime_observation: Many overt marker relations are absent, reduced to children, or masked by generic graph parents.
candidate_clusters.expected_parser_benefit: A coordinated terminal map can unlock several common clause-linking profiles while preventing eleven duplicate identities or broad fallbacks.
dependencies: targeted corpus or panel plans for weaker units
risks: generic parent nodes are implementation evidence only
candidate_clusters.cancellation_condition: All relations compose transparently from accepted children with no missing semantic relation.

candidate_clusters.title: Postverbal aspect profiles V開, V落去, V起嚟
candidate_clusters.trigger: PRQ2-005–007 provide direct source decisions and 79 exact collision probes for habitual, continuative, and inchoative profiles.
candidate_clusters.evidence_state: Each profile is source-backed; bounded corpus and role-neutral contrast packets remain required.
candidate_clusters.runtime_observation: V開 is reduced to lexical/generic action, continuative 落去 to directional motion, and inchoative 起嚟/起上嚟 to directional motion; discontinuous objects are missed.
candidate_clusters.expected_parser_benefit: Correct three common aspectual domains and reduce systematic lexical/directional false analyses.
risks: risk of one broad aspect fallback
candidate_clusters.cancellation_condition: Existing lexical, aspect, and directional identities represent every supported profile.

candidate_clusters.title: Classifier/measure evidence-typed metadata
candidate_clusters.trigger: Accepted audit found the current compatibility layer conflates unit-word sense, construction eligibility, noun-choice evidence, structural NP, and downstream policy.
candidate_clusters.evidence_state: Primary-source audit and exact twelve-rule inventory define a behavior-preserving schema migration.
candidate_clusters.runtime_observation: Current behavior can remain unchanged, but metadata ambiguity blocks safe classifier/measure expansion and can mislabel missing evidence as incompatibility.
candidate_clusters.expected_parser_benefit: Create a safe evidence architecture for later noun/classifier growth and prevent structural fixtures from being treated as linguistic pair evidence.
risks: no direct parser coverage gain in the first PR
candidate_clusters.cancellation_condition: Current structures already preserve all required distinctions.

candidate_clusters.title: AA84 manner profiles
candidate_clusters.trigger: Accepted source synthesis separates gam2, dei2, and bare-reduplication routes and rejects the current AA84 intersection as the independent family definition.
candidate_clusters.evidence_state: Primary-source profiles are established; three corpus/native packets remain required.
candidate_clusters.runtime_observation: Runtime undercovers nonreduplicated gam2 and dei2 profiles and overgenerates bare written-equality reduplication without tone or lexical controls.
candidate_clusters.expected_parser_benefit: Improve a productive manner domain while eliminating hidden-marker and surface-equality overgeneration.
candidate_clusters.cancellation_condition: Existing identities cover all routes and only the generic fallback needs behavior-preserving removal.

candidate_clusters.title: Modal/desiderative/preference decomposition
candidate_clusters.trigger: Source audit found heterogeneous lexical scope, complement, polarity, and ellipsis profiles; ModalVP occurs on 172 Glossika turns.
candidate_clusters.evidence_state: Two direct sources establish the problem, but lexeme-stratified corpus and controlled contrasts are incomplete.
candidate_clusters.runtime_observation: Broad modal × VP inference can mask narrower availability, A-not-A, desiderative, preference, and ellipsis relations.
candidate_clusters.expected_parser_benefit: High eventual leverage across frequent modal input, but only after scope is narrowed by lexeme and complement type.
risks: risk of fragmenting lexemes or preserving an unsourced umbrella
candidate_clusters.cancellation_condition: Existing narrow identities and lexical rules already preserve every supported distinction.

candidate_clusters.title: Scalar progression and near-miss operators
candidate_clusters.trigger: PRQ2-003 and PRQ2-004 establish separate source-backed profiles with 48 collision probes.
candidate_clusters.evidence_state: Direct source decisions exist; corpus, polarity, marker, and host-event boundaries remain incomplete.
candidate_clusters.runtime_observation: Paired 越 scales, 越嚟越 progression, and 差啲/爭啲 near-miss relations are missing or falsely absorbed by generic scalar, quantity, similarity, or fragment analyses.
candidate_clusters.expected_parser_benefit: Add common degree/event operators and improve negative boundaries around broad scalar fallbacks.
risks: lexical 越過 and approximate quantity collisions
candidate_clusters.cancellation_condition: Existing scalar and event structures preserve both relations without new identities.
candidate_clusters.notes: Related to existing issue #392 but does not duplicate alternative-choice scalar evaluation.

candidate_clusters.title: Resultative and lexical change profiles
candidate_clusters.trigger: Accepted reconciliation supports a causative-resultative research family and separates four lexical change/state/cessation profiles while retaining retired wrappers as retired.
candidate_clusters.evidence_state: Primary-source synthesis exists; five classified corpus/judgment packets remain.
candidate_clusters.runtime_observation: Broad retired wrappers are invalid, but genuine result/change relations are not yet assigned safe identities or composition.
candidate_clusters.expected_parser_benefit: Recover central result/change behavior without reviving exact-string wrappers or one universal result node.
candidate_clusters.cancellation_condition: Existing result, aspect, and lexical identities cover all profiles and no evidence remains unhomed.
